source: R2.8.1a: 5 warm + 5 fresh-boot + 5 post-rebuild runs, pooled
note: Timings only. The deterministic WORK profile of each workload lives beside its spec in desk/test-data/perf/<w>/profile.txt and is asserted by the generated shard; a change there is an ordinary test failure. This store exists so tools/tier3-report.py can say how far a run drifted, and NOTHING gates on it -- R2.8.1a measured the median workload at 15.6% run-to-run on a fresh boot, over its own +/-15% bar, so tier 3 ships report-only.
